unit.why: This is a homiletic and halakhic discussion of mikveh immersion for scholars, quoting the Lev Same'ah prayer book, Dvar Moshe and the Belz rebbe, and it closes with a prayer and an announcement of a second volume; nothing happens to anyone, so there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the mikveh discussion from the previous division and closes this section of the book; the next division begins a new section.
